hypotheses.text: If CB Oscar Lindqvist had been 3 m closer to Leo Marchetti, Marchetti's chance to score would have fallen noticeably, showing the assist exploited a gap that a tighter central defender could have closed.

If LB Dario Kesh had been 5 m closer to Leo Marchetti, Marchetti's chance to score would have been reduced, indicating the pass was better than the passer's alternative of relying on a more covered shooting lane.
